verdict.rationale: Deel documents employer-side sponsorship as a service: sponsoring work permits through the company's own entities or through Deel's EOR entities, processing visa transfers, and handling company forms and filings. H-1B appears only in a founders visa list, and there is no mention of H-1B registration/lottery or LCA compliance. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration and transfer service, LCA filing/public-access-file compliance, detailed employer-petition paperwork documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service
